name: Scholar
source:
Of the thousands of students attending Arlington Academy, Scholar is one out of ten that were granted a scholarship.

You can decide what Scholar's name, gender, and department are during Chapter 0. If you become dissatisfied with your choices at any time, you can change your Scholar's name and gender by going to your profile page or by replaying Chapter 0. If you want to switch departments, you will have to replay Chapter 0. Regardless of your preferences, it is possible to romance any one of the Main 10.

[From [url=https://sweetelite.fandom.com/wiki/Scholar]Sweet Elite Wiki[/url]]
